# Liliav — Private Plastic Surgery Concierge

> Liliav is an independent plastic surgery brokerage and concierge service connecting
> international patients with vetted, board-certified plastic surgeons and accredited
> clinics across the United States, Turkey, and Lebanon. Liliav does not perform surgery;
> it arranges private consultations, transparent itemized quotes, travel, recovery, and
> a full year of scheduled aftercare. Services are offered in English, Arabic, and Turkish.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://liliav.com/): Overview of the concierge service, the four-step Liliav Journey, featured procedures with indicative pricing, and destinations.
- [Procedures](https://liliav.com/procedures): 24 procedures across Face & Head, Breast, Body, Hair Restoration, and Non-Surgical — each with recovery timelines, ideal-candidate criteria, price guidance for the USA/Turkey/Lebanon, and FAQs.
- [Destinations](https://liliav.com/destinations): Plastic surgery in the USA, Turkey, and Lebanon — accreditation standards, clinic vetting process, travel logistics, and recovery environments.
- [Surgeon Network](https://liliav.com/surgeons): Vetting standards — board certification verified at source, 10+ years in practice, accredited facilities only.
- [The Journey](https://liliav.com/journey): Eight stages from private inquiry to one year of aftercare, including concierge travel and recovery retreats.
- [Results](https://liliav.com/results): The results philosophy — transformation presented tastefully, without before-and-after photography.
- [About](https://liliav.com/about): The Liliav story and commitments.
- [Contact](https://liliav.com/contact): Free private consultation request (multi-step form), phone, and WhatsApp.
- [Journal](https://liliav.com/journal): Editorial guidance on aesthetic travel, consultations, rhinoplasty, and safe surgical travel.
- [Medical Disclaimer](https://liliav.com/legal/disclaimer): Liliav is a facilitator, not a medical provider; outcomes vary and none are guaranteed.
